Hit@1.relevance_definition: Binary hit if any top-1 retrieved paper_id is in expected_paper_ids
Hit@1.handling_no_relevant: Returns 0.0 for answerable items, 1.0 if gold is empty and top-1 empty
Hit@1.handling_multiple_relevant: Any match in gold set yields Hit@1 = 1.0

Hit@5.relevance_definition: Binary hit if any top-5 retrieved paper_id is in expected_paper_ids
Hit@5.handling_multiple_relevant: Any match in top-5 yields Hit@5 = 1.0

Recall@5.relevance_definition: Ratio of unique retrieved gold paper_ids in top-5 to total gold paper_ids

Precision@5.relevance_definition: Ratio of unique retrieved gold paper_ids in top-5 to 5.0

MRR.relevance_definition: Reciprocal of 1-based rank of first matching paper_id across full returned list
MRR.handling_multiple_relevant: First hit rank determines reciprocal rank

NDCG@5.relevance_definition: Discounted Cumulative Gain normalized by Ideal DCG for top-5 positions using binary relevance
NDCG@5.handling_multiple_relevant: Binary relevance at each position log2(rank+1)
